original_german_name: Anteil der Arbeitslosen an den sozialversicherungspflichtig Beschäftigten zuzüglich Arbeitslose (%)
definition: Registered unemployed / (social-insurance employees + registered unemployed). Not the official all-civilian-labour-force unemployment rate.
comparability_limitations: Workbook export has no exact reference-date, revision or complete boundary-history metadata. Same year is an annual comparison, not proof of an identical observation day. No causal or individual-level conclusions. Missing values are not imputed.

original_german_name: Anteil der sozialversicherungspflichtig Beschäftigten an der Bevölkerung im Alter von 15 bis unter 65 Jahren (%)
definition: Social-insurance employees at residence / population aged 15 to under 65. Excludes self-employment and civil servants; low values are an imperfect labour-market disadvantage proxy.
comparability_limitations: Workbook export has no exact reference-date, revision or complete boundary-history metadata. Same year is an annual comparison, not proof of an identical observation day. No causal or individual-level conclusions. Missing values are not imputed.

original_german_name: Anteil der Leistungsberechtigten (Grundsicherung für Arbeitsuchende, SGB II) an der Bevölkerung unter 65 Jahren (%)
definition: SGB II entitled recipients / population under 65. Measures receipt, not all poverty or unmet need; includes employed recipients.
comparability_limitations: Workbook export has no exact reference-date, revision or complete boundary-history metadata. Same year is an annual comparison, not proof of an identical observation day. No causal or individual-level conclusions. Missing values are not imputed.

original_german_name: Anteil der Leistungsberechtigten (Grundsicherung für Arbeitsuchende, SGB II) an der Bevölkerung unter 15 Jahren (%)
definition: SGB II entitled recipients under 15 / population under 15. Overlaps overall benefit receipt; not independent evidence.
comparability_limitations: Workbook export has no exact reference-date, revision or complete boundary-history metadata. Same year is an annual comparison, not proof of an identical observation day. No causal or individual-level conclusions. Missing values are not imputed.

original_german_name: Gesamtbetrag der Einkünfte je Steuerpflichtigen (1000 EUR): Median
definition: Median total income per taxpayer, thousand EUR. Taxpayer unit differs from person/household; not disposable income. Latest year 2020.
comparability_limitations: Workbook export has no exact reference-date, revision or complete boundary-history metadata. Same year is an annual comparison, not proof of an identical observation day. No causal or individual-level conclusions. Missing values are not imputed.
